semiconductor_relevance: High — Continium Technologies is a fabless semiconductor company specializing in high-speed data converters, which are critical components in various semiconductor applications.
summary: Continium Technologies is a fabless semiconductor company focused on the design and development of high-speed data converters using Continuous Time Sigma-Delta (CTSD) technology. Their products are designed for high performance and efficiency, catering to sectors such as telecommunications, medical devices, and automotive applications.
